text:
Iris Walker: quick heads-up — Next.js starter with LangChain example hits a streaming stall when refresh TTL is short. Logs show repeated 401s and reconnects. Repro in branch langchain-next-starter-edge. @Noah @Jules

Noah Kim: can you paste the exact log snippet and SDK versions?

Iris Walker: node 18, next 13.4.7, @redwood/sdk@0.8.2, @redwood/browser-sdk@0.4.1, langchain@0.1.0. Snip:

```
-> /api/chat/stream 401 {error: 'expired'}
client refresh -> 200 {token: 'a1'}
reconnect -> 401 {error: 'invalid_grant'}
client refresh -> 200 {token: 'b2'}
...repeat...
```

Jules Park: sounds like a propagation race; starter reconnect code immediately retries without backoff. Short-term fix: add single retry + 150ms jitter before reconnect in streaming helper. Long-term: expose retryPolicy in SDK so browser/node parity possible.

Noah Kim: agree. I'll open an SDK PR adding `retryPolicy.on401 = 'single'` and a `tokenStalenessWindowMs` option. Also add a unit that simulates delayed token acceptance.

Iris Walker: I'll patch the example to use the helper and update README with troubleshooting steps + a pointer to issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-starters/issues/101

ci-bot: CI run 2345 started for branch langchain-next-starter-edge :gear:

Jules Park: also add a note about Dedicated deployments sometimes needing longer propagation — call it out in the starter README so users on Private/Dedicated don't get confused.

Noah Kim: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/223 opened. Assigning Jules for review.

Iris Walker: thanks — if CI is green I'll cut a patch release for the starter templates later today.
